name: learnt
description: Learning-first development for pi, omp, opencode, Codex and Claude Code.
author: NoksLabs LTD <max@nokslabs.com>

scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:pi && bun run build:opencode
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli.ts --define LEARNT_VERSION="\"$npm_package_version\"" --target=node --format=esm --outfile=skills/learnt/scripts/learnt.mjs && chmod +x skills/learnt/scripts/learnt.mjs
scripts.check: bun audit && bun run typecheck && bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- skills/learnt/scripts adapters/pi adapters/opencode/learnt.js && bun test
